transactions.description: San Francisco Giants traded 2B Nate Furman to Washington Nationals for LHP Tony Neubeck.
transactions.description_zh: 舊金山巨人將 2B Nate Furman 交易到華盛頓國民，換取 LHP Tony Neubeck。

transactions.description: Texas Rangers signed free agent RHP Enrique Pantoja to a minor league contract.
transactions.description_zh: 德州遊騎兵與自由球員 RHP Enrique Pantoja 簽下小聯盟合約。

transactions.description: Washington Nationals designated LHP Richard Lovelady for assignment.
transactions.description_zh: 華盛頓國民將 LHP Richard Lovelady 指定讓渡。

transactions.description: Boston Red Sox placed RHP Inj Ured on the 15-day injured list.
transactions.description_zh: 波士頓紅襪將 RHP Inj Ured 放入 15 天傷兵名單。

news.title: Giants acquire Furman from Nationals
news.summary: San Francisco and Washington swapped infielders. Nate Furman heads east.
